title: How three extensions changed a $6.08 million pandemic grant finding

beats.text: Three San Francisco emergency grants came with short spending windows.
Two ended on April twenty-first. The shelter award ended April thirtieth.

visual.kicker: Three emergency awards had different deadlines

beats.text: Auditors found costs incurred outside those dates.

visual.kicker: The City corrected its federal schedule

beats.text: The federal share was more than six million dollars.
The City reduced its schedule of federal expenditures.

visual.kicker: The City corrected its federal schedule

beats.text: The audit reported no remaining questioned costs.
The following audit records a change to the awards themselves.
Extensions covered the dates behind the original finding.
All three federal project titles now end on June thirtieth.
We matched 3 worksheets to 6 federal obligation transactions.
Each initial award and its later increase reconcile to the federal total.

visual.kicker: Six federal transactions reconcile to the three awards

beats.text: Those totals cannot tell us when an individual invoice was paid.
